# doc-pipeline-engine

> Document processing pipeline engine —  adapters, contracts, domain packs, eval harnesses

## Getting Started

- [README](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/): Project overview and quickstart
- [Contributing](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/CONTRIBUTING/): Setup, quality commands, plugins, optional extras

## Architecture & Design

- [Architecture](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/architecture/): Stage graph, contracts, runtime modes, design decisions
- [Roadmap](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/roadmap/): Versioned milestones (0.1 → 0.6+)
- [Prototype plan](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/prototype/plan/): Dual-variant E2E prototype (Claude vs Python tools)

## Tool surveys

- [Landscape — Ingest](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/landscape/ingest/): Extraction backends, source connectors, crawling
- [Landscape — Process](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/landscape/process/): Chunking, NER, RAG indexing, normalization
- [Landscape — Output](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/landscape/output/): Rendering, office formats, templating, conformance
- [Landscape — E2E systems](https://qte77.github.io/doc-pipeline-engine/landscape/e2e-systems/): End-to-end pipeline competitors, prior art, and USP positioning
